subject.title: [Feature]: Intelligent Model Fallback with Wildcard/Auto Selection

question: Should OpenClaw add a core provider-family model fallback contract for this issue, and if so should it be wildcard/auto refs, explicit fallback families, or catalog-derived candidates?
rationale: The implementation would change public model config and provider routing semantics; automation cannot safely choose the durable config shape or provider-boundary policy.

options.title: Sponsor narrow core contract
options.body: Add an explicit opt-in provider-family fallback design with schema/docs/tests and reconcile it with existing fallbacks and provider/* allowlists.

options.title: Route to plugin/provider policy
options.body: Keep core explicit-only and require provider plugins or routing hooks to own dynamic model selection outside the fallback config contract.

options.title: Wait for catalog PR outcome
options.body: Defer this issue until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/60922 either lands, is replaced, or closes, then reassess the remaining wildcard/auto gap.

recommendation.title: Sponsor narrow core contract
recommendation.body: Add an explicit opt-in provider-family fallback design with schema/docs/tests and reconcile it with existing fallbacks and provider/* allowlists.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest history across the fallback resolver and the config-contract guardrails that this product choice would affect.
